listing.name: Nadekoverse
listing.summary: Adds 101 profile pictures of the same anime character to the game.
listing.aiSummary: Adds 101 profile pictures of the same anime character to the game.

description:
What is your brand, as a person who presumably uses pseudonyms and profile pictures to make a first impression on others on the Internet? What image do you cultivate?

Here's mine, curated over three years, turned into a proof of concept.

Made for personal use, I present to you: Nadekoverse. This is my first mod for Starsector. It contains 101 previous profile pictures I made for myself of the exact same character with the exact same album art in the background.

Get it here (Google Drive)!

Features:

Faction grouping of images based on the outfit the character is wearing in the image.Populates for females only to attempt not to dilute the image pool too much.You get a .png of an anime girl without having to gamble  for it.

I'm sure you have questions on these choices. I will attempt to answer them without spoiling much.

Q: Why Nadeko, an initially problematic character from a problematic anime?

A: Once Nadeko gets her own arcs where she is both main character and unreliable narrator, she outright rejects the harem and almost every associated member entirely - highly unusual for any character in a harem anime.  At first, this is done with force, and it gives her voice actress (usually typecast for derederes) an opportunity to do the villain performance she's looked forward to since the beginning of her career. In each arc, Nadeko grows considerably as a person, and she's been steadily more approved of by the broader viewerbase the more screentime she gets. Non-archetypal, subversive dynamism in writing is hard to achieve, especially if the source material is a light novel (no offense to LN readers). As for problematicism, art history is filled with period examples of depictions that are not generally accepted now (and at times weren't accepted then). If we accept a broad definition of art as a medium consciously manipulated by a human, then we must be willing to give leeway to all provocations that disarm and unsettle not for the sake of provocation itself, but in this case to create a character with a murky morality that brings clarity to the murkiness over time via considerable effort and tribulation.

Why ska punk?

A: I love ska punk. It is so unabashedly fun! I sometimes listen to albums that are intended as challenging experiences or indulgent outlets of heavy emotions. Not every album has to be like that. I love Streetlight Manifesto, Reel Big Fish, and Goldfinger because I love brass sections inserted into upbeat punk songs with downbeat lyrics that I can belt out at the top of my lungs in my car with the speakers turned up.

Somewhere In the Between

is one of my most-listened to albums in the genre, and I find its album art simple yet visually interesting enough on the merit of the color palette and the geometric designs alone.

changelog.1.1.0: Updated the nadekoverse.version file to actually have the ID of this mod thread. Still had the mod thread ID of the mod I dissected to make this project. Big credit to atreg for having a 0.98a-updated portrait pack, by the way. I probably could've done it without something to reverse-engineer, but it would've taken longer than one evening.
